name: PPL-1U-HD-FX Propel fixed fibre panel, 4 x 24-fibre positions
source: CommScope Propel fixed panel user manual (TC-96342-IP) and PPL-4U product page
notes: 1RU fixed Propel panel, 2 blades of 12 lanes each. Modules and adapter packs come in 8, 12, 16 and 24-fibre sizes (2, 3, 4 or 6 lanes); here each position is one 24-fibre (6-lane) module, 4 per panel (48 LC duplex). PPL-1U-HD-FX-OPEN is the reduced-depth version. Check: blade layout (shown as two columns per RU).

frame.controller: None (passive). Takes Propel modules, adapter packs and splice cassettes.

frame.controller: None (passive). Takes Propel modules, adapter packs and splice cassettes.

name: PPL-4U-HD-FX Propel fixed fibre panel, 16 x 24-fibre positions
source: CommScope Propel fixed panel user manual (TC-96342-IP) and PPL-4U product page
